notes.title: Small correction and a question for you!
notes.notes: Just a little correction about that super-hidden treasure chest in Indonesia level. We wanted to let you know that on Discord and in the Hub, we asked a really important and intriguing question for you, dear players!

notes.title: Mushroom Kingdom Bug fixed and minor corrections!
notes.notes: Some players experienced a bug to obtain the secret cat in the Mushroom Kingdom level! We are immensely grateful to everyone who reported it. You are incredible. We fixed the bug earlier today. Oh, by the way, some little kittens have changed their spots. They can be mischievous. Now, they've stopped hiding under the UI buttons. Have a great game, everyone!
